article.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
article.summary: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.
